metas.name: Dangal
metas.description: Dangal is an extraordinary true story based on the life of Mahavir Singh and his two daughters, Geeta and Babita Phogat. The film traces the inspirational journey of a father who trains his daughters to become world class wrestlers.

metas.name: October Sky
metas.description: The true story of Homer Hickam, a coal miner's son who was inspired by the first Sputnik launch to take up rocketry against his father's wishes.

metas.name: A Street Cat Named Bob
metas.description: James Bowen, a homeless busker and recovering drug addict, has his life transformed when he meets a stray ginger cat.

metas.name: Goodbye Christopher Robin
metas.description: The behind the scenes story of the life of A.A. Milne and the creation of the Winnie the Pooh stories inspired by his son Christopher Robin.

metas.name: American Underdog
metas.description: The true story of Kurt Warner, who went from a stockboy at a grocery store to a two-time NFL MVP, Super Bowl champion, and Hall of Fame quarterback.

metas.name: Miss Potter
metas.description: Beatrix Potter, the author of the beloved children's book "The Tale of Peter Rabbit", struggles for love, happiness and success.
